# `assets/vehicle/WheelDetector.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/vehicle/WheelDetector.js`

engine/assets/vehicle/WheelDetector.js — find wheels (spec §11).  Detection chain (cheap → expensive), each a HINT with a confidence, never an assertion: name match → cylinder geometry → symmetry / low-corner position → (editor correction). Wheels that are merged into the body mesh won't be found here and fall through to the editor (see VehicleRigBuilder.needsCorrection).

## Functions

### `detectWheels(model, opts = {})`

Detect wheel candidates in a model.

**Returns:** >}
